ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast with approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral sections of both lobes. The right lobe features a solid white block from tip to mid-section. The left lobe has a similar white region heavily bifurcated by low-intensity linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 70-degree aperture and a deep central depression relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct peaks of 5-15 pixels in amplitude visible on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature leading to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tip of the right lobe and sparsely on the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear scars (rake marks) on the left lobe, including prominent diagonal and vertical strikes that contrast sharply with the underlying white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the left lobe and barnacle colonization on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive cross-hatch pattern of linear abrasions located in the central-lateral region of the left lobe.
